title: Construction and internal validation of a machine learning model for predicting 30-day readmission after hip surgery.
summary: A retrospective single-center comparison of eleven models selected XGBoost to predict 30-day readmission after hip surgery; internal test validation included decision-curve and SHAP analyses. No external or prospective clinical utility was established.
ai_technology: XGBoost was selected from eleven machine-learning models to predict 30-day hip-surgery readmission.
